newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: NWE oil products dip, prompt product demand low.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products dip, prompt product demand low.

text.p: NWE oil products began weaker on Thursday morning, with again only limited interest in prompt product, dealers said.
Heating oil barges dropped by over $2 a tonne as IPE gas oil futures fell. Early morning physical talk was little changed from Wednesday's close, at around April IPE flat.
High sulphur fuel oil barges initially traded at $86 fob Rotterdam, then at $85. Mid-morning offers were at $85/$85.50 with bids at $83, representing a fall of about $1 a tonne.
Initial bunker market volume was low, traders said.
